newsitem.title: USA: Gov Pataki sets news conference on NYC river park.
newsitem.headline: Gov Pataki sets news conference on NYC river park.

text.p: New York State Gov George Pataki has scheduled a news conference for Thursday afternoon on a "major development" in plans for a park for New York City's waterfront.

In a schedule of his events for Thursday, the governor said the 550-acre park stretched along five miles of the city's waterfront, from Battery Park to 59th Street, Pier 62 Park at 23rd Street, north Chelsea Piers.
No further details were immediately available.
